construction: First valid original and at least one +/-15 mm edit with identical ball position prefixes and no prior contact at both rates. Two 60 Hz frames from the scheduled construction tick. Ordinary pools are consecutive unedited standard releases.
primary: Parent-mean accuracy for identity of the next distinct surface or no second begin by two frames, free release at the prescheduled tick. Primary branches require a unique first begin and matching order at two rates, no equal-time ties or more than two begins. Parent bootstrap head minus analytic with three seeds retained per parent, 2000 draws. Report all strata separately.
controls: Four equal subdivisions per frame, bounded two impact slots per frame with the identical friction/restitution law, gated and ungated sweeps, frozen E2 with positive-slope affine logit calibration on independent enriched and ordinary cohorts. Same analytic paths for conditional heads. Compare parent-averaged hard accuracy, timing, tails, false flips and latency.

selection.risk_fit: Separate risk fitting and threshold halves of calibration parents. Two equally sized logistic readouts of worst predicted goal margin and analytic or learned first-encounter features. Compare full final risk/coverage curves and thresholds frozen at 80% of proposed calibration repairs. One selection and no retries.

follow_up: Advance event-aligned B/C/D only for a positive lower parent-bootstrap bound on primary learned gain and evidence of decision value or lower cost. Report lower latency independently of learned gain.
